mapper.select: select rr.id as id, r.id as resourceId, r.resource_code as resourceCode, r.resource_name as resourceName, r.resource_type as resourceType, rr.granted_by as grantedBy, rr.created_at as createdAt, rr.role_id as roleId from universe_life_user.resource r inner join universe_life_user.resource_role rr on r.id = rr.resource_id where rr.role_id = #{roleId} and r.deleted = 0

select r.id as id, r.role_code as roleCode, r.role_name as roleName from universe_life_user.resource_role rr inner join universe_life_user.role r on rr.role_id = r.id where rr.resource_id = #{resourceId} and r.deleted = 0

select count(*) from universe_life_user.user_role ur inner join universe_life_user.resource_role rr on ur.role_id = rr.role_id inner join universe_life_user.resource r on rr.resource_id = r.id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.resource_code = #{resourceCode} and r.deleted = 0
